segments.t: What changed in the current release. The version this guide was built for is shown in the footer.

KTPH000Choose how agent runs lookKTPH001 — KTPH002Plugins → AI Agent DesignKTPH003 (also KTPH004View → AI Agent Panel → Design...KTPH005) decides how runs of the terminal AI agent are shown: as blocks in the terminal above the prompt, in a slim bar below or above it, on a rail or in a column beside it, as a card floating over it, or in the classic activity panel. A combination picks one design for each role (history, status, approval, arrangement) with a live preview; the new default shows the run as a block in the terminal with a metro-line status bar, and each connection can pick its own combination on the connection editor's AI tab. See KTPH006AI agent designsKTPH007.
KTPH000More status displaysKTPH001 — Powerline, minimap, top bar and neon displays, and the remaining designs of the catalogue, complete the choice. See KTPH002More status displaysKTPH003.

KTPH000Context window in the profileKTPH001 — an Integrated llama.cpp profile has a KTPH002Context windowKTPH003 row with a number field and a slider, from 512 tokens up to the context the model was trained for; saving the profile applies it to the model. New local chat models start with 32,768 tokens, or less when the model was trained for less, so dense models still load on common hardware. See KTPH004Configure and run modelsKTPH005.

KTPH001GPU backend and runtime package matchKTPH002 — saving a model with Metal or Vulkan while another runtime package is active now offers to install and activate the matching signed package, and the KTPH003BackendKTPH004 column shows a mismatch such as KTPH000. See KTPH005Configure and run modelsKTPH006.

KTPH000Self-contained Windows runtimesKTPH001 — the llama.cpp packages for Windows no longer depend on OpenSSL libraries of the build machine, so KTPH002Install runtimeKTPH003 works on a clean system, and a failed health check is reported instead of rolling back silently.

KTPH000Truncated agent replies are reportedKTPH001 — when a model cuts the agent's reply off at its token limit, the run stops with a message that names the token counts and points to the model's context size or the profile's maximum output tokens, instead of ending with an empty response.

KTPH000Connection Manager in the toolbarKTPH001 — the icon toolbar's Tools group now starts with a Connection Manager button; saved layouts gain it once, and removing it is remembered. See KTPH002Customizing the icon toolbarKTPH003.
KTPH002Ctrl+V pastes in the terminal on WindowsKTPH003 — as in Windows Terminal; Linux keeps KTPH004KTPH000KTPH005+KTPH006KTPH001KTPH007 for the shell. See KTPH008Pasting textKTPH009.
KTPH000Dark title bars on WindowsKTPH001 — in dark mode the main window and all dialogs get a dark native title bar, and a system theme switch reaches open windows.

KTPH000Local shells come backKTPH001 — KTPH002Restore Previous SessionKTPH003 reopens local shell tabs started from the toolbar instead of parking them as "connection missing". See KTPH004Session RestoreKTPH005.

KTPH000Focus ring can be switched offKTPH001 — switch off KTPH002Frame the split pane the keyboard is inKTPH003 in the Window settings to hide the ring around the active split pane. You then recognize the active pane by its cursor. See KTPH004TabsKTPH005.
KTPH003Terminal agent on PowerShell and cmdKTPH004 — an intercepted KTPH000 line is cleared without a stray KTPH001, and nested KTPH002 scripts from the model run correctly.

KTPH000Folder analysis by fileKTPH001 — the folder analysis tab lists the folder's files beside the report. Pick a file, or step through the files with ◀ ▶ and the arrow keys, to see only its findings and a short description of what the file does; each row shows how many of its findings are ticked, and its checkbox ticks or clears them all. Findings keep their file even when the model numbers them per file or names the file another way. See KTPH002Analysing a folder as one projectKTPH003.
KTPH000Agent prompts fit the panelKTPH001 — a pending approval or password prompt grows a collapsed agent panel until the prompt is fully visible.

KTPH000AI confirmation explainedKTPH001 — a hint under KTPH002Show confirmation dialog before sending AI requestsKTPH003 names the actions it covers, and the KTPH004SaveKTPH005 button of the General, Local AI and AI Skills tabs sits at the bottom right. See KTPH006AI settingsKTPH007.
KTPH000Recording and journal icons follow the themeKTPH001 — they no longer turn black in the AtlantaFX designs.
